sections.heading: Repair or Replace After High Winds? The 25% Rule for West Orange Roofs

c.v: What is the 25% rule for roofing?

runs.v: When wind damage covers more than about 25% of the roof, replacement usually makes more sense than another repair, and roof replacement is necessary for widespread damage. Under New Jersey's ordinary-maintenance rule, repairs under 25% of the total roof area need no building permit, while larger roofing projects need permits based on scope and property type, and full replacements or structural repairs often require a construction permit, except that a detached one- or two-family re-roof counts as ordinary maintenance. Wind damage repairs should ensure structural safety and compliance with local guidelines.
